data: reuse v15 verified short snapshot; no fetching or DB writes
signal: previous 5 complete action-adjusted session returns, same v15 common eligibility; ascending return, ties stock code

control_existing: v15 REV_equal reused after snapshot/features/engine and sample replay agreement
missing: missing held signal/required sizing close, insufficient replacement, unknown held action, unavailable ordered execution flag invalid; retain diagnostics; no hidden fill
ordering: corporate-action entitlement -> yesterday NAV/signals -> replacement decisions -> scheduled equalweight of resulting25 -> settlement -> valuation -> compliance
settlement: single net order vector per day, never roundtrip same stock; prior close target formula; actual daily turnover/volume price; fees paid cash; receivables not spendable
